classification.ground_truth_independence: true_label comes from dual independent AI annotators (independent_ai_annotation). Index metadata was not used as gold. This is not human gold. Residual correlated AI error is expected.

questions.y_hat_note: This implementation does not use a variable named y_hat. In the literature ŷ (y_hat) is the predicted label; here that value is y_pred, taken from classify_chunk(...).subcategory or classify_question(...).subcategory. Accuracy compares y_true == y_pred with exact string equality. There is no probability cutoff applied at metric time.
questions.threshold_note: The classifier itself uses RULE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.72 to keep a rule result and LOW_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.45 to skip LLM fallback. Those thresholds choose which internal method produces the subcategory. They are not applied to y_pred when scoring accuracy/F1.

retrieval.ground_truth_independence: relevant_ids / graded_relevance are human-reviewed against the isolated 691-chunk chroma_evaluation corpus. Notes on rag_benchmark_04 and rag_benchmark_05 document source conflicts rather than post-hoc label flipping.

citation_set_precision.limitation: Per-case numeric citation scores are not stored in per_case_metrics.json. This recalculation only confirms the documented five-case title-match formula (1+1+0.5+1+1)/5. It is not gold chunk-id citation_set_precision.

per_case.question: How much does it cost to get a copy of my Transcript of Records?
per_case.note: Undergraduate P75.00/page and graduate P150.00/page match the pending Charter fee lines. Extra process/time not PDF-checked. No sources visible.

per_case.question: How much is the fee for a second copy of my diploma?
per_case.note: P100.00 matches the Charter second-copy-of-diploma line. Extra process/time not PDF-checked.

per_case.question: Which office handles student enrollment?
per_case.note: Office of the Registrar is correct. Four duplicate Citizen's Charter Enrollment source chips.

per_case.question: How much does it cost to drop a subject?
per_case.note: Stated only Charter P30.00. Missed student-visible Handbook P20/unit conflict required by the pending multi-document case.

per_case.question: What is the fee for library circulation service if my book is overdue?
per_case.note: Invented unit 'per day'. Extraction only has '2 pesos per' with unit missing.

per_case.question: How long does the LSPU entrance examination take, including orientation?
per_case.note: 15 minutes + 1.5 hours match. Invented official total 1 hour 45 minutes; Charter total processing time is Not specified.

per_case.question: What is the process for validating my student ID?
per_case.note: COR, BAO student ID, OSAS steps, 4 minutes, no fee match the ID Validation card. Visible source title looks like neighboring Student ID Processing.

per_case.question: What happens if I fail more than 75% of my units?
per_case.note: OCR-garbled table dump. Did not state dismissal / nine-unit condition / 100% permanent disqualification.

per_case.question: How is faculty teaching load determined?
per_case.note: Student-role refusal. Faculty Manual is faculty-audience only. Stock student message hides that a Faculty Manual exists. Not counted as a generator error.

per_case.question: What are the responsibilities of an LSPU faculty member?
per_case.note: Same student-role gate as aq_09. Faculty Manual Section III.A is not student-visible.

per_case.question: What is honorable dismissal for a student?
per_case.note: Voluntary withdrawal + Registrar is correct. Missed parent petition, debts, no readmission, and disciplinary exclusion. Mixed in withdrawal guidelines.

per_case.question: Who is the current LSPU president?
per_case.note: Named Dr. Mario R. Briones as in dated manuals, but asserted current and added unsourced 2019 / Flexible Learning / ISO biography. Pending case is insufficient_evidence for 'current'.

per_case.question: What is the weather on Mars tomorrow?
per_case.note: Refused. Did not invent weather. Stock student insufficient-information / OOS message.

per_case.question: What is the LSPU student Wi-Fi password?
per_case.note: Did not invent a password. Added Portal URL and IT Support instructions not present in the evaluation corpus.
